summary: Iter 229b backend verification — Trade Builder same-year multi-draft differentiator. Bug fix VERIFIED: GET /api/teams/{id}/draft-picks returns each pick with both `draft_id` AND `draft_name` populated, and the (draft_id, year, round, original_team_id) tuple is unique even when multiple drafts share the same year. 47/47 tests pass (37 iter228 regression + 5 TFHL heal + 4 new iter229b contract + 1 TFHL real-data spot-check). Real TFHL spot-check confirms 61 picks across 3 distinct drafts (Inaugural=55, Entry=4, Winter=2) with 4 (year,round) overlap-buckets and zero duplicate-draft-id collisions — exactly the scenario the frontend chip needs to disambiguate.
critical_code_review_comments: drafts.py L391-475 — `get_team_draft_picks` correctly decorates every pick with `draft_id` + `draft_name` + `draft_scheduled_time`. The explicit-then-fallback strategy (prefer `pick.draft_id`, fall back to (league_id, year)) handles both new and legacy picks. ONE latent gap: when there are TWO drafts with the SAME year and a pick has no explicit `draft_id`, the year-fallback collapses both to the first inserted draft (drafts_by_year only writes if `key not in drafts_by_year`). Practical impact today is zero because the iter228s fix ensures all new picks are seeded with `draft_id` populated, but legacy/orphan picks in a multi-draft-per-year league could be silently misattributed. Recommend logging a metric when fallback fires.

POST /api/drafts response shape uses `_id` (Mongo-style) rather than the standard `id` field returned by /api/leagues. This inconsistency caught my first test draft and is a foot-gun for client code. Recommend mirroring `id` alongside `_id` in the draft create response.
drafts.py is still 3211 lines (>700 threshold) — repeatedly flagged from iter116 → iter117 → iter229b. Not blocking but the cumulative cost of grepping a single 3k-line route file is meaningful.

The new iter229b tests + iter228p/q/s tests all read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from os.environ at import time without load_dotenv. They pass via `set -a; source .env` but bare `pytest backend/tests/` collection will fail. Add `load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env'); load_dotenv('/app/frontend/.env')` at the top of test modules to harden the suite (small follow-up).

rca of the issue: User reported: '2026 Rd 2' from Inaugural and '2026 Rd 2' from Entry were indistinguishable in the Trade Builder cart because the displayed label only used (year, round). Root cause: while the backend (iter228o) already decorated each pick with `draft_id` + `draft_name`, the frontend TradeDraftPick interface didn't carry those fields through, so the cart card had nothing to render. Fix: (a) backend continues to surface draft_id+draft_name per pick (verified by 4 new contract tests + 1 real-data spot-check); (b) frontend TradeBuilder.tsx now defines draftId?/draftName? on TradeDraftPick; (c) TradeDraftPickCard derives a short chip (INAUGURAL/ENTRY) and renders it via data-testid='trade-pick-draft-label-{id}'; (d) TeamDraftPicks.tsx handleTradePick fans in _draftId/_draftName from the live API pick. Backend tests confirm the data path is intact end-to-end; data-integrity invariant (unique (draft_id,year,round,original_team_id)) holds.
